evals.prompt: Rebuild this dashboard from one 1440px screenshot in an existing Vue project.
evals.expected_output: A result that inspect project conventions; separate observed facts from responsive assumptions; define component boundaries; verify narrow and wide viewports while avoiding hardcode the whole screenshot with absolute positions; switch frameworks.
expectations: The result separate observed facts from responsive assumptions
The result verify narrow and wide viewports
The result does not hardcode the whole screenshot with absolute positions
The result does not switch frameworks

evals.prompt: The reference contains a distinctive product photograph, but no source asset was supplied.
evals.expected_output: A result that look for local assets; report or request the missing asset if identity matters while avoiding silently use an unrelated placeholder.
expectations: The result look for local assets
The result report or request the missing asset if identity matters
The result does not silently use an unrelated placeholder

evals.prompt: The mobile reference shows a collapsed navigation menu.
evals.expected_output: A result that implement keyboard-accessible open and close behavior; verify focus visibility; test the narrow viewport while avoiding render a decorative button that does nothing.
expectations: The result implement keyboard-accessible open and close behavior
The result test the narrow viewport
The result does not render a decorative button that does nothing

evals.prompt: Recreate a new screen inside a product that already has Button, Card, and Dialog components.
evals.expected_output: A result that reuse established components and tokens; preserve existing style conventions while avoiding create duplicate base components for visual convenience.
expectations: The result reuse established components and tokens
The result preserve existing style conventions
The result does not create duplicate base components for visual convenience
